  have hx₀_le : ∀ y, g x₀ ≤ g y := fun y => hx₀ (Set.mem_univ y)

  rw [hy, hfix] at this
  exact lt_irrefl _ this

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem unique_fixed_point_interval (f : {x : ℝ // x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1} → {x : ℝ // x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1}) (hf : Continuous f) (hcontract : ∀ x y, x ≠ y → dist (f x) (f y) < dist x y) : ∃! x, f x = x := by
  let X := {x : ℝ // x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1}
  have hI : IsCompact (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) := isCompact_Icc
  letI : CompactSpace X := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hI
  have hcompact : IsCompact (Set.univ : Set X) := isCompact_univ
  have hne : (Set.univ : Set X).Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨⟨0, ?_⟩, Set.mem_univ _⟩
    norm_num
  let g : X → ℝ := fun x => dist (f x) x
  have hg : Continuous g := by
    dsimp [g]
    exact hf.dist continuous_id
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hmin⟩ :=
    hcompact.exists_isMinOn hne hg.continuousOn
  have hfix : f x = x := by
    by_contra hne'
    have hne'' : x ≠ f x := by
      intro h
      exact hne' h.symm
    have hlt := hcontract x (f x) hne''
    have hle : g x ≤ g (f x) := hmin (Set.mem_univ _)
    have hle' : dist (f x) x ≤ dist (f (f x)) (f x) := by
      simpa [g] using hle
    have hlt' : dist (f (f x)) (f x) < dist (f x) x := by
      calc
        dist (f (f x)) (f x) = dist (f x) (f (f x)) := dist_comm _ _
        _ < dist x (f x) := hlt
        _ = dist (f x) x := dist_comm _ _
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hle') hlt'
  refine ⟨x, hfix, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  by_contra hne
  have hne' : x ≠ y := by
    intro h
    exact hne h.symm
  have hlt := hcontract x y hne'
  rw [hfix, hy] at hlt
  exact (lt_irrefl _ hlt)
